technical.summary: CDW shows solid trend structure with price above all key MAs and bullish technicals, but overbought short-term oscillators (RSI-9, Stoch, Williams %R) and weak volume confirmation limit swing entry probability at current levels.

fundamental.summary: CDW shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 69 days.

sentiment.summary: No clear congressional signal with mixed small trades; market fear (40 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.2) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 69 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and MACD crossover up provides solid trend structure in a fear-driven market (VIX crisis) that historically rewards contrarian entries.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought short-term oscillators (RSI-9, Stoch 83.07, Williams %R), weak volume confirmation (0.57 ratio), zero fundamental conviction, inverted yield curve recession signal, and no active strategy trigger create a high-risk entry into macro headwinds with limited upside confirmation.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is sound with price above all major MAs and bullish trend, but overbought oscillators combined with weak volume confirmation and zero fundamental conviction make this a poor risk/reward entry point.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve recession signal combined with VIX crisis levels and overbought short-term technicals create macro headwinds that could trigger sharp reversal; earnings in 69 days add event risk without catalyst clarity.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Existing CDW position plus 49 open IT sector positions (15% of portfolio) create concentration risk; skip entry to reduce sector overlap and preserve capital in macro stress environment.
